_comment: Corrections to the identity keywords derived from skill data. Keys are identity ids (1SSNN). `skills` is how many base attack skills inflict the keyword — the unit conditional gifts count. `specialSkills` is how many inflict the 특수 variant (특수 충전 = 생체 재료 etc.), which only the '또는 특수 X' form of a condition counts. Identities listed here get keywordSource: "curated".
